about: Per-user defaults for scripts/kdp_publish.py. Copy to kdp_defaults.json (gitignored) to make them your own; this example is what a clone without one reads. `translator` is the one spelling every listing and every EPUB uses. `descriptors` is the public-domain title descriptor KDP requires in the title field ('(Translated)', '(Annotated)' or '(Illustrated)'), keyed by what the edition adds; the Spanish wording is a house choice that check flags for manual review. `edition_notice` is the template for the copyright page: {placeholders} are filled from facts.json and the listing, and a line whose placeholder has no value is dropped. Never name Project Gutenberg anywhere here: its trademark license bars the name on a commercial derivative. `keyword_stoplist` holds words a keyword should not spend characters on (KDP: 'information common to most items in the category'); check warns on them, it does not refuse. `subtitle` and `series` are the house's standing KDP Subtitle and Series fields (blank: decided per book). `variety_label` is how listings name the Spanish ('español latino'); blank lets the book's dialect decide. `publishing_rights` is the house answer to KDP's Publishing Rights question, 'public_domain' or 'own_copyright' (claimed on the translation and any original content; the skill confirms it per book).
